createIntro: Your data stays on this computer, encrypted. The study's Combray server keeps the key to it, hands that back only for your password, and never sees your data. Your password opens nothing anywhere else, so it is fine to keep it in a password manager. Forgot it? Questions at the top explains what you can do.
hint: At least {{min}} characters. Anything goes: words, numbers or both.
weak: This one is quite easy to guess. A few more characters make it much stronger, but it's up to you.
mismatch: The two passwords are not the same yet.
unlockIntro: Type your password to open your data on this computer.
wrong: That password does not open this space. Shall we try again?
wait_one: That was a few tries in a row, so let's pause for a moment. You can try again in {{count}} minute.
wait_other: That was a few tries in a row, so let's pause for a moment. You can try again in {{count}} minutes.
unreachable: We could not reach the Combray server just now. Your data is safe on this computer. Is it connected to the internet? Please try again in a moment.
storeGone: The key for this space no longer exists, so its data cannot be opened anymore. You can start over below and add your data again.
lockedAskReset: This space is locked after many wrong passwords in a row. The researchers can send you a link to choose a new one.
lockedStartOver: This space is locked after many wrong passwords in a row, and it cannot be opened anymore. You can start over below and add your data again.
confirmDelete: This deletes everything you added for this study on this computer. It cannot be undone. Continue?
autoLocked: We locked your data because Combray was not used for a while.
deleteAll: Delete everything for this study from this computer
invalidParticipant: This personal link does not seem quite right. Could you check it with the researchers?
resetIntro: The researchers sent you this link so you can choose a new password. Your data on this computer stays as it was.
resetInvalid: This link has already been used or has expired. Please ask the researchers for a new one.
askReset: Forgot the password? The researchers can send you a link to choose a new one. Or:
